description:
We are Team AegisFire (NASA Space Apps Raipur), tackling "Harmonization of MODIS & VIIRS Hot Spots". We harmonize NASA FIRMS satellite data to generate dynamic, life-saving wildfire evacuation corridors.

We already have a working prototype ready!

Looking for teammates in:

• UI/UX design & pitch slides

• Video storytelling / pitching

• Earth science & data research

All backgrounds welcome. Let's collaborate, create real impact, and win together! 🚀🔥
